'''D.J. Peralta''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Endor Regionals]] on 1 July 2000 with Ops on Ralltiir with Nightfall and spies, according to Greg Otte's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d981">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-05-endor-regional-seattle-wa-07-01-2000d981/ endor-regional-seattle-wa-07-01-2000], DeckTech (Greg "Rogue 9" Otte, 5 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-05-endor-regional-seattle-wa-07-01-2000d981/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
